name: Nothing-inspired
inspiration: Nothing / Nothing OS visual design (https://nothing.tech/). Independent fan interpretation, not an official asset pack.
prompt: Create one macOS app icon using the documented palette and geometry. A large recognizable app glyph on a charcoal rounded square, warm ivory glyph and restrained signal-red accent. Transparent outside the tile. Subtle matte shading, calm industrial graphic style; no external shadow, no neon, no tiny decorations, no app-name labels. Preserve the app's recognizable identity without presenting this as official artwork. The same asset must remain readable against light and dark backgrounds at 32-64px.
themePolicy: Use one fixed image for light and dark. macOS Clear/Tinted can transform its displayed material or colors; changing appearance does not remove the stored custom icon.
